title: De-duplicate near-identical CompletionDao test coverage between completion_dao_extended_test.dart and completion_dao_extra_test.dart
why: Both files were independently written against 'the baseline test' (each file's header says so) and ended up covering the same 5 methods — insertCompletionsBatch(seed helper), getCompletionsByTrackAndProfile, getAggregateCountByTrack, completionExistsByTrack, getCompletionsByDateRangeAndTrack — with near-identical happy-path/profile-scoping/empty-list scenarios. Neither file references the other. This doubles maintenance cost (a behavior change requires updating matching assertions in two places) for zero added coverage on 5 of the two files' groups; completion_dao_review_counts_test.dart by contrast adds real net-new scenarios (track/profile/ref filter edge cases) alongside minor overlap, so it's not implicated here.
recommendation: Merge the 5 overlapping groups into one file (extra_test.dart's cases look like a strict subset of extended_test.dart's), or add a comment in the newer file cross-referencing the older one so future authors know not to add a third copy.
acceptance_criteria: The 5 duplicated method groups exist in exactly one file, or the newer file documents what it adds beyond the older one.
Total assertion count for these 5 methods is unchanged or increased (dedup must not drop coverage).

corrections: Recommendation overclaims 'strict subset': completion_dao_extra_test.dart actually has MORE scenarios than completion_dao_extended_test.dart in the getCompletionsByTrackAndProfile and getAggregateCountByTrack groups, not fewer -- overlap exists but neither file is a clean subset of the other.
